records.section: Item pilot — g2-u03 (stages 5–8 calibration on the known-bad unit) / Protocol (operator session; every "spawn" is a FRESH agent session)

records.section: Item pilot — g2-u03 (stages 5–8 calibration on the known-bad unit) / Results / Pre-verify validator fold-back
records.requirementOrFinding: First `content validate` on the raw drafts: **78 reds** (71 V-5 level-gate, 3 V-9/V-17 distractor, 1 V-14 umlaut, plus the should/shouldn't grant gap). One fix agent round cleared 18 items; the rest were resolved by **hardening the validators themselves** (see fold-back log). The headline finding: the cumulative gate is *far* stricter than the brief's prose digest reads — bank multiword entries index as contiguous phrases keyed on their first token, so everyday-feeling words ("fly", "sing", "see", "people", "party", "home", "late", bare "pumpkin") are genuinely untaught at g2-u03. This is correct behaviour, not a bug; agents must probe the real matcher, never trust intuition.
